questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding effects of direct current is false?

questions.question: A patient with moderate chronic obstructive pulmonary disease performs an exercise test that will stress the patient to the point of limitation. During the test the therapist monitors the patient's physiologic response to exercise. Which of the following findings would not require cessation of the testing session?

options.A: A 20 mm Hg decrease in diastolic blood pressure with an increase in workload
options.B: Systolic hypertension greater than 160 mm Hg
options.C: A PO2 of less than 55 mm Hg

questions.explanation: Systolic BP above 160 mm Hg alone does not mandate stopping; falls in BP, low PO2 and maximal dyspnoea do.

questions.question: Although bulimic episodes (binge eating followed by vomiting) can occur in BOTH anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa, the key distinguishing feature is that patients with bulimia nervosa:

options.A: Usually maintain a near-normal body weight (or are overweight), unlike the marked underweight seen in anorexia nervosa
options.B: Always have amenorrhoea, unlike anorexia nervosa patients
options.D: Are exclusively male, while anorexia nervosa is exclusively female

questions.explanation: While bulimic episodes are common in anorexia nervosa, patients with bulimia nervosa usually maintain a near-normal body weight or are even overweight — sharply contrasting with the significant, often severe underweight state that defines anorexia nervosa.
questions.sourceBook: Ahuja, A Short Textbook of Psychiatry
questions.sourceChapter: Eating Disorders — Anorexia Nervosa, Differential Diagnosis

questions.question: Transverse friction massage is a valuable treatment technique in a variety of common musculoskeletal disorders. Which of the fllowing statements does not accurately describe the application technique of transverse friction massage?

options.B: A lubricant is used to prevent excessive skin friction
options.C: Fingers that are not involved directly in the massage are used to provide stabilization
options.D: The rate of movement is 2-3 cycles per second and rhythmical
